title: The agent stops writing while a subagent it started is still doing one of the asks
expected: While the subagent runs, the audit is work under way, not a request the agent overlooked and not a to-do for the user. Once the agent reports the result, the audit is done and nothing is listed as not addressed.

steps.user: Two things: bump the Node version in CI to 22, and audit our npm dependencies for known vulnerabilities.

tool.name: Task

input.prompt: Run npm audit in /srv/shop and list every package with a high or critical advisory, with the fixed version.

tool.output: Async agent launched successfully. It runs in the background; you will be notified when it completes.

steps.agent: CI runs Node 22 now. I started a subagent on the dependency audit; it is still running and I will report what it finds.

check.why: the audit is under way in a subagent; the agent has not overlooked it
the audit is the agent's job, not a to-do for the user
the Node bump is recorded as done

steps.agent: The audit is back: 3 high-severity advisories and no critical ones. lodash needs 4.17.21, axios 1.7.4 and minimist 1.2.8.

check.why: both things were done; nothing the user asked for is left unaddressed
the audit is recorded as done
